reason: B is the better, though still weakly grounded, proposal because Ti alloying offers a more physically plausible route to modifying BCC dislocation mobility and is tested across a concentration series. A improperly extrapolates carbon-induced TWIP/TRIP from a metastable Fe–Mn–Co–Cr dual-phase alloy to BCC NbMoTaW, where strong carbide formation and the absence of an identified transformable phase make its central mechanism unlikely.
